name: simple-inference-poc
description: CPU-only LLM harness for extracting structured flight details from emails and images

scripts.generate-client: npm run generate-openapi-spec && docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd):/local" openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate -i /local/openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o /local/generated-client
scripts.generate-client:npx: npm run generate-openapi-spec && npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate -i ./openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o ./generated-client
